    • initialize

      public static void initialize(@NotNull @NotNull File folder, @Nullable @Nullable Locale loc)
      Initializes the I18nUtil. This method is called whenever the plugin loads or reloads. Thread safety is ensured by synchronizing modifications of shared fields.
      参数:
      folder - The plugin's data folder.
      loc - The desired Locale. If null, Locale.ENGLISH is used.

    • setLocale

      public static void setLocale(@Nullable @Nullable Locale loc)
      Sets the Locale. Resets to the default locale if NULL is given. The I18n cache is cleared so that translations are reloaded.
      参数:
      loc - Locale to set.
